title: GitHarness: Git Init Your Harness Working Memory for Perpetual User Requirements
title_zh: GitHarness: Git 初始化你的代理工作记忆以实现永久用户需求

paragraphs.en: LLM-based agents increasingly collaborate with users on long-horizon tasks, accumulating evidence, code, and drafts through extensive search, reasoning, and execution. As users inspect these results, they may supply missing information ( requirement completion ), introduce new requirements ( requirement elicitation ), or revise existing ones ( requirement shift ). These changes often affect only part of the accumulated work, yet agents may carry forward obsolete information or turn local revisions into global rewrites. Existing approaches clarify current intent without determining how prior work should change, or reuse execution histories under a fixed objective. We address this gap by formulating perpetual-requirement collaboration as joint requirement tracking and local update. We introduce GitHarness , a pluggable Git -style framework that organizes requirement states and their corresponding harness work states into a branchable version history. A trainable Git Agent resolves requirement changes and selects a semantically compatible historical state. A unified version interface then restores that state and creates a new branch, enabling the underlying harness to exclude obsolete information, inherit compatible work, and focus execution on affected parts. The Git Agent is trained through interface-level black-box reinforcement learning, with downstream harnesses and task-execution models kept fixed. We also construct MTAgentBench , a verifier-preserving benchmark covering mathematical reasoning, text-to-SQL, agentic search, software engineering, and research synthesis. Experiments demonstrate strong task performance alongside effective requirement tracking, preservation of valid work, and efficient execution.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体越来越多地与用户在长期任务中协作，通过广泛的搜索、推理和执行来积累证据、代码和草稿。 当用户检查这些结果时，他们可能会提供缺失的信息（需求补充）、提出新的需求（需求挖掘），或修改现有需求（需求变更）。 这些变更通常只影响已积累工作的一部分，但智能体可能会将过时信息延续下去，或将局部修订转化为全局重写。 现有方法虽然能明确当前意图，却无法确定先前工作应如何调整，或在固定目标下重复使用执行历史。 我们通过将持续需求协作建模为联合需求跟踪与局部更新，来解决这一空白。 我们提出了 GitHarness——一个可插件化的 Git 风格框架，它将需求状态及其对应的执行器工作状态组织成可分支的版本历史。 一个可训练的智能体能够解决需求变更，并选择语义兼容的历史状态。 统一的版本接口随后会恢复该状态并创建新分支，使底层执行器能够排除过时信息、继承兼容的工作内容，并将执行聚焦于受影响的部分。 智能体通过接口层面的黑箱强化学习进行训练，同时保持下游执行器和任务执行模型固定不变。 我们还构建了 MTAgentBench——一个保留验证器的基准测试集，涵盖数学推理、文本转 SQL、智能体搜索、软件工程和研究综合等领域。 实验表明，该方法在任务表现上表现出色，同时实现了有效的需求跟踪、对有效工作的保留以及高效的执行。

Yet users rarely provide a complete and immutable task specification at the outset. As they inspect intermediate results, they may supply missing task information ( requirement completion ), introduce new requirements inspired by the results ( requirement elicitation ), or revise, replace, or withdraw existing requirements ( requirement shift ) ( Tack et al., 2026 ; Subramonyam et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2022 ; Faltings et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体（Bubeck 等，2023）如今能够执行长期任务，例如软件工程、开放世界搜索和深度研究（Guo 等，2025；Jaech 等，2024；Jimenez 等，2024；Zhou 等，2024；Xiong 等，2026；Du 等，2025）。 在执行过程中，它们会收集证据、制定计划、调用工具，并生成代码、查询和报告草稿等中间结果。 然而，用户很少在任务开始时提供完整且不可更改的任务说明。 在检查中间结果时，它们可能会补充缺失的任务信息（需求完善）、根据结果提出新的需求（需求挖掘），或者修改、替换或撤回现有需求（需求变更）（Tack 等，2026；Subramonyam 等，2024；Lee 等，2022；Faltings 等，2023）。

paragraphs.en: Unlike conventional multi-turn chat ( Lee et al., 2025 ) , the context of long-horizon agent collaboration includes not just dialogue but also the results of extensive search, reasoning, and execution . Subsequent user feedback often targets only part of this accumulated work. An agent must track active requirements and reuse valid context and results . In practice, however, a request to fix a single bug may trigger changes to unrelated files across the workspace ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , while a request to refine one visual detail may alter the entire image (Figure 1 ). A local revision can thus become a global rewrite, unnecessarily changing work that was already correct. This motivates our central research question: How can an agent harness adapt to changing user requirements while excluding obsolete information, preserving unaffected work, and updating only affected parts?

paragraphs.en: Retaining the full history risks carrying forward obsolete requirements and results, whereas restarting from current requirements discards potentially reusable work. Existing methods address this trade-off only partially. ❶ Context retrieval, summarization, and intent reconstruction help clarify the current request ( Dongre et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Su et al., 2026 ) , but do not directly determine how prior work should be reused, potentially requiring re-execution at substantial token and time cost. ❷ Trajectory organization, compression, and restoration support the reuse of intermediate work ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Zhuang et al., 2026 ) , but typically assume a fixed task objective; when requirements change, superseded requirements and their associated results may continue to influence execution ( Laban et al., 2026 ; Tack et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . The missing link is an explicit connection between requirement changes and decisions about which prior work to preserve, discard, or recompute.

paragraphs.en: Addressing this gap requires two linked decisions: where to resume —identifying the currently effective requirements and selecting a compatible historical state; and what to update —determining which parts of the prior work must change and which can be preserved. Version control offers a natural abstraction for these decisions. Git preserves versions through commits, supports branching from past states, and records local changes as diffs. This suggests a way to git init an agent’s working memory: organize requirements and their corresponding work as versioned states, and treat each new piece of feedback as a branch update from an appropriate historical state.

paragraphs.en: We propose GitHarness , a pluggable framework that couples requirement states and work states in a branchable version history. A trainable Git Agent interprets requirement changes and selects compatible historical states, while a unified version interface supports restoration and continued execution across different harnesses without retraining the underlying task executors.

paragraphs.en: We construct MTAgentBench , covering mathematical reasoning, text-to-SQL, agentic search, software engineering, and research synthesis under diverse requirement-change trajectories. The dataset provides structured annotations of requirement states, version transitions, and task completion, together with an evaluation protocol for cross-task and compositional requirement changes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 MTAgentBench，涵盖了数学推理、文本转 SQL、智能体搜索、软件工程和研究综合等多个领域，并模拟了多样化的需求变化轨迹。 该数据集提供了需求状态、版本转换和任务完成的结构化标注，同时还包含用于跨任务和组合式需求变化的评估协议。

paragraphs.en: A user request may be disclosed, extended, or revised over several turns, making the latest utterance insufficient on its own. Existing methods maintain user-side history by appending previous turns, retrieving relevant dialogue ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , summarizing context, rewriting conversational queries ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) , or modeling relations such as follow-up, correction, expansion, and recall ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Intent-mismatch methods further separate intent mediation from task execution ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , while U-Fold constructs an intent-aware dialogue summary and a task-relevant tool log for evolving user intent ( Su et al., 2026 ) . Despite these advances, models remain anchored to early assumptions under progressive disclosure and struggle with intent revelation, revision, and redirection ( Laban et al., 2026 ; Tack et al., 2026 ) . These approaches clarify current intent but do not determine how changes propagate to evidence, code, drafts, and other work produced under earlier requirements .
paragraphs.zh: 用户请求可能在多个回合中被披露、扩展或修订，导致仅凭最新发言无法完整理解其意图。 现有方法通过追加过往回合内容来维护用户侧的历史记录，包括检索相关对话（Zhang 等，2025）、总结上下文、改写对话式查询（Yuan 等，2025），或建模后续提问、修正、扩展和回忆等关系（Li 等，2025）。 意图不匹配方法进一步将意图协调与任务执行分离（Liu 等，2026），而 U-Fold 则构建一个具备意图意识的对话摘要和一个与任务相关的工具日志，以应对不断变化的用户意图（Su 等，2026）。 尽管取得了这些进展，模型在渐进式披露场景下仍受早期假设的束缚，难以处理意图的揭示、修订和转向问题（Laban 等，2026；Tack 等，2026）。 这些方法虽然能明确当前意图，但并未说明变化如何传播到依据早期要求生成的证据、代码、草稿及其他成果中。

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon agents accumulate extensive traces and intermediate artifacts during planning and tool use. Memory methods organize, compress, or retrieve this execution-side history through stack operations, subgoal-based trajectories, active context editing, or state-adaptive recall ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) . Recovery methods diagnose consequential failures or restore aligned agent and environment checkpoints ( Qi et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Zhuang et al., 2026 ) . Related systems further introduce version-control abstractions: GCC manages context through commit, branch, merge, and retrieval ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , while GitOfThoughts stores reasoning trees as Git repositories ( Shekar et al., 2026 ) . These methods make prior execution easier to reuse, but select history according to the agent’s current reasoning state, an execution failure, or exploration needs under an otherwise given task. They therefore lack a requirement-driven mechanism for deciding which historical work state remains compatible when user feedback changes the task itself . In contrast, GitHarness uses requirement transitions to locate compatible historical states and decide what work to preserve, discard, or recompute.
paragraphs.zh: 长期规划智能体在规划和工具使用过程中会积累大量轨迹和中间产物。 记忆方法通过栈操作、子目标导向的轨迹、主动上下文编辑或状态自适应回忆等方式，对执行端的这些历史记录进行组织、压缩或检索（Jiang 等，2025；Hu 等，2025；Li 等，2026；Hu 等，2026）。 恢复方法能够诊断关键性失败，或恢复智能体与环境之间的对齐检查点（Qi 等，2026；Ma 等，2026；Zhuang 等，2026）。 相关系统进一步引入了版本控制抽象：GCC 通过提交、分支、合并和检索来管理上下文（Wu 等，2025），而 GitOfThoughts 则将推理树存储为 Git 仓库（Shekar 等，2026）。 这些方法使过往的执行过程更容易复用，但会根据智能体当前的推理状态、执行失败或特定任务下的探索需求来选择历史记录。 因此，当用户反馈改变任务本身时，它们缺乏一种基于需求的机制来决定哪些历史工作状态仍然兼容。 相比之下，GitHarness 利用需求转换来定位兼容的历史状态，并决定哪些工作应保留、丢弃或重新计算。

paragraphs.en: Overall Effectiveness (RQ1). Across two backbones, three agent harnesses, and five task domains (Table 1 ), GitHarness outperforms Native in all 30 settings and matches or exceeds the strongest competing baseline in 28, including 27 strict wins and one tie. paragraphs.en: Component Ablation (RQ2). Table 2 shows that both requirement resolution and branch execution contribute to performance and efficiency. Removing historical version selection and falling back to latest-state resolution , which fixes the current head as the base instead of selecting an earlier version, reduces the Code resolved rate from 74.0 to 44.0 while increasing token usage from 1.29M to 4.51M; without Inspect , the resolved rate falls to 42.0 with 4.22M tokens. paragraphs.en: Memory-Introduced Guidance (RQ4). In Table 3 and 11 , we build a non-parametric guidance memory by distilling reusable strategies from multi-turn inference trajectories on separate source datasets and retrieve relevant guidance at test time. The memory is fixed and collected following SkillRL Xia et al. (2026) when training, and contains no evaluation instances, reference answers, or task-specific evidence; Search, Code, and Research provide no trajectories for its construction. Memory guidance improves 13 of 15 settings, including a 5.0 -point gain on StackPlanner SQL and Research gains across all three harnesses, ranging from 2.07 to 4.27 points. These results show that experience accumulated during prior inference improves most of the evaluated settings, including held-out tasks, without parameter updates or test leakage.

paragraphs.en: GitHarness presents a Git-style version-tracking framework for long-horizon agent collaboration under dynamic user requirements. Instead of mixing evolving requirements and accumulated work in a flat interaction history, GitHarness binds each effective requirement to its corresponding harness state and organizes them as a branchable version history. Given users’ new feedback, a Git Agent reconstructs the current requirement, locates a compatible historical state, and guides the underlying harness to preserve valid work, discard obsolete states, and update only the affected content. Across five task domains, two backbone models, and three agent harnesses, the training-free GitHarness configuration outperforms native cross-turn execution in all 30 settings and matches or exceeds the strongest competing baseline in 28 of 30 settings, including 14 of 15 settings under DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Moreover, after interface-level RL adaptation, the 8B Git Agent retains strong performance despite its smaller capacity, outperforming native cross-turn execution in 29 of 30 settings.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate GitHarness on five benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, text-to-SQL generation, web search, software engineering, and deep research. Only Math and SQL provide training trajectories for RL adaptation; Search, Code, and Research are held out entirely from RL training and serve as out-of-domain transfer evaluations. The Math and SQL candidate pools contain 400 tasks in total: 200 are used for RL training and 200 are reserved for validation. Table 7 summarizes the task-disjoint training, validation, and test splits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五个基准测试上对 GitHarness 进行了评估，这些测试涵盖数学推理、文本到 SQL 生成、网络搜索、软件工程和深度研究。 只有数学和 SQL 提供了用于强化学习适应的训练轨迹；搜索、代码和研究则完全排除在强化学习训练之外，用作域外迁移评估。 数学和 SQL 的候选任务池总共包含 400 个任务：其中 200 个用于强化学习训练，另外 200 个保留用于验证。 表 7 总结了任务分离的训练、验证和测试划分情况。

paragraphs.en: GSM8K contains 8.5K linguistically diverse grade-school math problems requiring multi-step arithmetic reasoning. From 200 candidate tasks, we use 100 for RL training and hold out 100 for validation; a separate 100-task test set is used for final evaluation. We evaluate the final answer using normalized exact-match accuracy, where extracted numerical answers are normalized before comparison with the gold answer.
paragraphs.zh: GSM8K 包含 8.5K 个语言多样化的小学数学问题，这些问题需要多步骤的算术推理。 我们从 200 个候选任务中选取 100 个用于强化学习训练，保留 100 个用于验证；另有独立的 100 个任务组成的测试集用于最终评估。 我们使用归一化精确匹配准确率来评估最终答案，其中提取出的数值答案在与标准答案比较前会先进行归一化处理。

paragraphs.en: BIRD is a large-scale, database-grounded text-to-SQL benchmark containing 12,751 question–query pairs across 95 databases and 37 domains. From 200 candidate tasks, we use 100 for RL training and hold out 100 for validation; a separate 100-task test set is used for final evaluation. We report execution accuracy by executing the predicted and gold SQL queries on the same SQLite database and comparing their returned results; gold SQL and execution results remain evaluator-only.
paragraphs.zh: BIRD 是一个大规模、基于数据库的文本转 SQL 基准数据集，包含来自 95 个数据库和 37 个领域的 12,751 组问题–查询对。 我们从 200 个候选任务中选取 100 个用于强化学习训练，保留 100 个用于验证；另有独立的 100 任务测试集用于最终评估。 我们通过在同一个 SQLite 数据库上执行预测 SQL 查询和标准 SQL 查询，并比较其返回结果来报告执行准确率；标准 SQL 和执行结果仅对评估器可见。

paragraphs.en: BrowseComp-Plus extends BrowseComp with a fixed, human-verified document corpus designed to provide controlled conditions for evaluating search agents. We use 100 queries and evaluate the final answers using normalized exact-match accuracy. Citation validity is additionally recorded as diagnostic information but is not used to determine the primary accuracy score.
paragraphs.zh: BrowseComp-Plus 在 BrowseComp 的基础上扩展了一个固定且经过人类验证的文档语料库，旨在为搜索智能体的评估提供受控条件。 我们使用 100 条查询，并通过归一化的精确匹配准确率来评估最终答案。 此外，还会记录引用有效性作为诊断信息，但该信息不会用于确定主要准确率得分。

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench Verified contains 500 human-validated software engineering tasks derived from real GitHub issues. We construct a fixed subset of 100 tasks and evaluate the resulting patches in isolated environments using the official SWE-bench evaluation harness, with the resolved outcome as the success criterion.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench Verified 包含 500 项经过人类验证的软件工程任务，这些任务源自真实的 GitHub 问题。 我们构建了一个由 100 项任务组成的固定子集，并在隔离环境中使用官方的 SWE-bench 评估框架对生成的补丁进行评估，以问题解决作为成功标准。

paragraphs.en: DeepResearch Bench contains 100 PhD-level research tasks spanning 22 expert-curated domains, with 50 English and 50 Chinese queries. We use all 100 tasks and evaluate generated reports using RACE, which measures report quality against the benchmark’s reference reports under its predefined evaluation criteria.
paragraphs.zh: DeepResearch Bench 包含 100 项博士级别的研究任务，涵盖 22 个由专家精心挑选的领域，其中包含 50 条英文查询和 50 条中文查询。 我们使用全部 100 项任务，并通过 RACE 评估生成的报告；RACE 会根据其预定义的评估标准，将报告质量与基准中的参考报告进行比较。

paragraphs.en: For each source task, we construct a multi-turn interaction sequence using three controlled transition classes. Preserve retains the current goal and active requirements while revealing compatible information, changing presentation, or requesting further explanation. Extend keeps the current task active while adding a constraint, comparison dimension, or related task function. Revise corrects, replaces, withdraws, or restores an active requirement. By construction, the final effective query is semantically equivalent to the original source task, allowing the final artifact to be evaluated with the benchmark’s original evaluator.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个源任务，我们使用三种受控的转换类别来构建一个多轮交互序列。 Preserve 会保留当前目标和活跃要求，同时揭示兼容信息、改变呈现方式或请求进一步解释。 Extend 会保持当前任务处于活跃状态，同时添加一个约束条件、比较维度或相关任务功能。 Revise 会修正、替换、撤销或恢复某个活跃要求。 根据构建方式，最终的有效查询在语义上与原始源任务等价，因此最终产物可以使用基准测试的原始评估器进行评估。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate multi-requirement tracking and cross-task interference, we compose multiple task-disjoint seven-turn interaction sequences into a single conversation with H ∈ { 10 , 15 , 20 , 25 , 30 } H\in\{10,15,20,25,30\} user turns. The conversation interleaves two to four active tasks, and each turn may update one task or jointly update several tasks. When needed to reach the target length, we insert continuation or progress-check requests (e.g., “continue working” or “report the current progress”) that leave the active requirements unchanged. Hidden task states and transition labels remain unavailable to the agent. The final turn requests the outputs of all active tasks, which are verified separately using their benchmark-specific evaluators and then macro-averaged.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估多需求跟踪和跨任务干扰，我们将多个任务互不相关的七轮交互序列组合成单个对话，其中 H ∈ { 10 , 15 , 20 , 25 , 30 } H\in\{10,15,20,25,30\} 为用户轮次。 该对话穿插了二到四个活跃任务，每一轮可能更新一个任务或同时更新多个任务。 当需要达到目标长度时，我们会插入延续或进度检查请求（例如，“继续工作”或“报告当前进度”），这些请求不会改变活跃的需需求。 隐藏的任务状态和转换标签对智能体仍然不可见。 最后一轮会要求所有活跃任务的输出，这些输出将使用各自基准测试专用的评估器进行单独验证，然后进行宏观平均。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate all methods with three agent harnesses: TC-RAG, StackPlanner, and OpenHands. Each harness retains its native reasoning and tool-use procedure, while a lightweight adapter connects it to the corresponding benchmark interface.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用三种智能体框架来评估所有方法：TC-RAG、StackPlanner 和 OpenHands。 每个框架都保留其原有的推理和工具使用流程，同时通过一个轻量级适配器将其连接到相应的基准测试接口。

sents.zh: 我们使用三种智能体框架来评估所有方法：TC-RAG、StackPlanner 和 OpenHands。

paragraphs.en: TC-RAG Jiang et al. (2025) employs a memory-stack mechanism for adaptive retrieval, reasoning, and planning. Through Push and Pop operations, it manages intermediate states, controls the retrieval process, and mitigates the accumulation of erroneous knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: TC-RAG Jiang 等人 (2025) 采用了一种内存栈机制，用于自适应检索、推理和规划。 通过“压入”和“弹出”操作，该机制管理中间状态、控制检索过程，并减少错误知识的累积。

sents.zh: TC-RAG Jiang 等人

paragraphs.en: StackPlanner Zhang et al. (2026) is a centralized hierarchical multi-agent framework that decouples high-level coordination from subtask execution. It employs active task-level memory control and structured experience memory to support long-horizon coordination and the reuse of prior coordination experience.
paragraphs.zh: StackPlanner Zhang 等人 (2026) 是一个集中式分层多智能体框架，它将高层协调与子任务执行解耦。 该框架采用主动的任务级记忆控制和结构化经验记忆，以支持长期协调并复用先前的协调经验。

paragraphs.en: OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) is a general-purpose platform for developing AI agents that interact with their environment by writing code, operating through a command line, and browsing the web. It also provides sandboxed environments for safe code execution.
paragraphs.zh: OpenHands（Wang 等人，2025）是一个通用平台，用于开发能够编写代码、通过命令行操作以及浏览网页与环境交互的人工智能智能体。 它还提供了沙盒环境，以实现安全的代码执行。

paragraphs.en: We compare GitHarness with four baselines that adopt different strategies for cross-turn context management: native state retention, context reconstruction, context compression, and versioned context management.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 GitHarness 与四种采用不同跨回合上下文管理策略的基线方法进行了比较：原生状态保留、上下文重构、上下文压缩以及版本化上下文管理。

paragraphs.en: Native directly relies on the conversational state and workspace maintained by the underlying task harness, without introducing any additional cross-turn context-management module. Information from previous turns is therefore retained only through the harness’s native state mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: Native 直接依赖底层任务框架所维护的对话状态和工作区，无需引入任何额外的跨轮次上下文管理模块。 因此，先前轮次的信息仅通过框架的原生状态机制得以保留。

sents.en: Information from previous turns is therefore retained only through the harness’s native state mechanism.
sents.zh: 因此，先前轮次的信息仅通过框架的原生状态机制得以保留。

paragraphs.en: Restart reconstructs the accumulated user requirements at each turn into a self-contained query and executes it in a fresh harness session with a clean workspace. Previous reasoning traces and intermediate artifacts are discarded, so each turn is solved independently based on the reconstructed requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 重启会将每一轮中累积的用户需求重新构建为一个自包含的查询，并在一个全新的运行环境中以干净的工作区执行该查询。 之前的推理轨迹和中间产物会被丢弃，因此每一轮都基于重构的需求独立解决。

paragraphs.en: U-Fold ( Su et al., 2026 ) retains the full user–agent dialogue and tool-call history while constructing a compact working context at each turn. It maintains an intent-aware, evolving dialogue summary together with a compact, task-relevant tool log, which are used to support the current interaction.
paragraphs.zh: U-Fold（Su 等人，2026）在每轮交互中构建一个紧凑的工作上下文的同时，保留了完整的用户与智能体的对话及工具调用历史。 它维护一个具备意图感知能力且持续演进的对话摘要，以及一个紧凑且与任务相关的工具日志，用于支持当前的交互过程。

paragraphs.en: When the final message requests outputs for several active tasks, the experiment scheduler extracts one task-local request for each referenced task and invokes the same GitHarness procedure independently on its version history and workspace. Each invocation produces one terminal Commit or Reuse , after which the scheduler aggregates the task outputs into one response. Thus, a global final message may trigger several task-local terminal actions without changing the single-handoff semantics of GitHarness.
paragraphs.zh: 当最终消息请求多个活跃任务的输出时，实验调度器会为每个被引用的任务提取一个任务特定的请求，并分别在其版本历史和工作空间上独立调用相同的 GitHarness 程序。 每次调用都会产生一个终端的提交或重用操作，之后调度器会将各任务的输出汇总为一个响应。 因此，一条全局的最终消息可能会触发多个任务特定的终端操作，而不会改变 GitHarness 的单次移交语义。

paragraphs.en: Figures 7 and 8 show that GitHarness does not collapse to a single resolution action or execution strategy. During requirement resolution, the Git Agent most frequently selects Commit in Math, SQL, Search, and Research, whereas Code more often reuses an existing requirement version; Inspect is particularly common in Code and Research. During branch execution, FreshSolve is most frequent in Math and SQL, ReuseAndPatch dominates Research and is common in Search, and ExactReuse dominates Code. These domain-dependent patterns show that GitHarness adapts both its historical-version selection and downstream execution strategy to the current update.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 和图 8 显示，GitHarness 并未简化为单一的解析动作或执行策略。 在需求解析阶段，Git Agent 最常选择“提交”操作，涉及数学、SQL、搜索和研究领域；而 Code 则更倾向于复用现有的需求版本；“检查”操作在 Code 和研究领域中尤为常见。 在分支执行阶段，FreshSolve 在数学和 SQL 领域最为频繁；ReuseAndPatch 在研究领域中占主导地位，并在搜索领域也较为常见；ExactReuse 则在 Code 领域中占据主导。 这些依赖具体领域的模式表明，GitHarness 会根据当前更新调整其历史版本的选择以及下游的执行策略。

paragraphs.en: When a verified workspace is available, the following prompt decides whether the downstream executor should solve from scratch, reuse and patch the workspace, or inspect it before deciding. The change_hint is a non-authoritative summary generated by the Git Agent from model-visible interaction history; it contains no evaluator reference, gold answer, or gold edit.
paragraphs.zh: 当有可用的已验证工作区时，以下提示将决定下游执行器是应从头开始解决、复用并修补该工作区，还是在决定前对其进行检查。 change_hint 是由 Git Agent 根据模型可见的交互历史生成的非权威性摘要；其中不包含评估者参考、标准答案或标准编辑内容。
